usage: 山景 is used as a noun to describe the view of mountains you can see from a place.
It can be used to highlight a selling point of a property, like 'This flat has a nice 山景.'
You can say '我鍾意呢個山景' to express your liking for the mountain view.
山景 can function as an attributive noun, for example '山景房' means a room with a mountain view.
Use 山景 to compare places, e.g. '呢度嘅山景好過嗰度嘅.'
